scope: The 3 admitted X509_VERIFY_POLICY production obligation(s) in src/x509/v3_utl.rs that the enumerated SSH closure reports as reachable but without an owning boundary receipt are enumerated here for ownership only, at their census coordinates, with a hazard read from each function. This receipt claims no discharge, no contract and no new reachability finding.
non_claims: This receipt does not discharge any site, and no site may be treated as discharged on its authority.
This receipt does not contract any site; the hazard notes are enumeration notes, not established contracts.
This receipt does not assert reachability; reachability is taken from the enumerated closure and is not re-established here.

boundaries.hazard: NULL-or-live ASN1_ENUMERATED is converted through ASN1_ENUMERATED_to_BN; the owned BN is freed and the returned heap string is caller-owned or NULL on failure.
NULL-or-live ASN1_INTEGER is converted through ASN1_INTEGER_to_BN; the owned BN is freed and the returned heap string is caller-owned or NULL on failure.
NUL-terminated string is parsed with raw pointer arithmetic that strips an optional '-' and 0x/0X prefix; the returned ASN1_INTEGER is caller-owned or NULL.
